annotations.title: Payment graph: nodes and payer→payee edges

description:
Entities as nodes and settlements aggregated into edges, over a bounded window. Two window forms, and exactly one may be sent: `window=N` is a row count running to the live tip (briefly cacheable); `days=N` covers **whole UTC days only**, excluding today, so an answer is stable for the day. Use `days` for anything an agent will cache. Self-payments are excluded from BOTH edges and node totals and counted in `meta.excluded`, so `sum(node.window_usd)` is exactly twice `sum(edge.usd)`.

Wraps GET /v0/graph.
Access: requires an API key (Authorization: Bearer rh_live_… or x-api-key).

Returns:
- applied: Every parameter as APPLIED, not as requested — both windows, the edge cap, the facilitator caps, the chain, the filters. Read this rather than assuming the request was honoured verbatim. `days` and `window` can BOTH be non-null: a wallet-focused day window is read row by row, so a row cap applies inside the declared range and `complete` says whether it bit.
- complete: Whether the declared window was read in full. False means a row cap stopped the read inside the range — the response then covers the newest `applied.window` settlements in it, not the whole of it, and `meta.warnings` says so. Only `?days=` with `?wallet=` can be false.
- days: The whole-UTC-day window applied, or `null` on the `window=N` path.
- since: Inclusive start of the day window, or `null` on the `window=N` path.
- until: Exclusive end of the day window (midnight today), or `null` on the `window=N` path.
- since_day: The `since` bound as a UTC date, or `null`.
- until_day: The `until` bound as a UTC date, or `null`.
- mode: `daily` when the answer came from the per-day rollup, which covers the window exactly; `raw` when it was folded from settlement rows.
- bucket: What one source row represented: `day` under `mode: daily`, `settlement` under `raw`.
- truncated: True when the edge cap dropped edges the window contained.
- nodes: One entry per wallet: role, display name, ENS, and its window totals.
- edges: Aggregated payer→payee pairs with volume and count.
- series: Per-day bucket totals across the window. `null` on the `window=N` path, which is a row count with no day grain to bucket into.
- facilitators: Relayers seen in the window, largest first and capped to `applied.facilitators`. `usd`/`count` are the relayer's own window totals; `links` name only wallets present in `nodes`, capped to `applied.facilitator_links`, with `links_total` and `links_truncated` beside them.
- window: How the window was read: rows requested, fetched and used.
- meta: The chain served, `as_of`, and `excluded` — the self-payments, low-confidence rows, over-cap edges and over-cap facilitators the window held but the graph does not show, so node and edge totals can be reconciled. `below_min_usd` is `null` when `min_usd` was sent: that filter runs at read time, so its exclusions never reach this response and cannot be counted.

chain.description: CAIP-2 chain id. Defaults to the chain this deployment indexes (`eip155:8453` in production, `eip155:84532` on staging) — the same default every endpoint on this API uses. A chain the index does not carry is refused with 400 listing the supported set, never answered with an empty list.

days.description: Whole UTC days, excluding today, honoured exactly: `days=1` is one day. Mutually exclusive with `window`. Out of `[1,180]` is refused rather than clamped.

edges.description: Hard cap on edges returned, highest volume first. Honoured exactly; `truncated` says whether it bit.

min_usd.description: Drop settlements below this USD value.

via.description: Restrict to settlements relayed by this facilitator key or wallet.

wallet.description: Restrict to edges touching this wallet. Must be a well-formed EVM address (case-insensitive) or Solana address (base58, case-sensitive).

window.description: Row count back from the live tip. Mutually exclusive with `days` — sending both is refused with 400, not silently resolved in favour of one.
